Privacy

Your files stay yours.

Doceo is built local-first. There’s no account to create and no server holding your work.

Stored on your device

Notes, folders, documents, tasks and calendar data are saved as files in your user data folder.

Works offline

Nothing in the core app needs a connection. Write on a plane, plan in a tunnel.

Portable

Copy the folder to a new computer to bring everything with you. Your documents are standard formats.

Where the files live

Doceo keeps everything in one folder. You can open it, back it up, or move it.

# macOS
~/Library/Application Support/<doceo-data>/
# Linux
~/.local/share/<doceo-data>/
# Windows
%APPDATA%\<doceo-data>\

  notes/    # one file per note
  folders/  # folder details
  docs/     # Page-view documents as .docx
  store/    # tasks, calendar and settings
  trash/    # deleted notes you can restore

<doceo-data> is Doceo’s own folder inside your user data directory. Exports (PDF, Word and more) are saved wherever you choose in the Save dialog — Doceo never picks a folder for you — and the Exports tab of the Files page remembers where each one went.

When Doceo uses the internet

Only for things you choose to turn on:

  • Calendar subscriptions. If you add an .ics link, Doceo downloads that link to show its events.
  • Microsoft 365 sign-in. If you connect your Microsoft calendar, you sign in on Microsoft’s own page in your browser. Doceo asks only to read your calendar, keeps the token on your computer, and you can disconnect at any time.
  • Links you click. External links open in your browser.

What we don’t do

  • No Doceo account, sign-up or login
  • No cloud storage of your documents
  • No advertising or analytics inside the app
